description: Coordinate multiple specialist perspectives for complex tasks.

# Orchestrate

$ARGUMENTS

Use this prompt for complex work requiring multiple domain viewpoints.

## Required Perspectives

Always include at least 3 perspectives:
- Architecture/planning
- Implementation (backend/frontend/database as needed)
- Verification (testing/security/performance)

## Two-Phase Flow

1. Planning phase
- Define scope, constraints, and milestones.
- List required specialists and responsibilities.
- Ask for approval before heavy implementation.

2. Execution phase
- Execute workstreams.
- Consolidate outcomes into one coherent result.
- Include validation and residual risks.

## Output Template

## Orchestration Report
- Task: <summary>
- Workstreams: <list>
- Findings/changes: <list>
- Validation done: <list>
- Risks/open items: <list>
- Recommended next action: <single action>
